title: Correlation analysis of a novel artificial intelligence optical microscope-assisted semen assessment system with IVF outcomes
summary: ArXiv v1 PDF (2022-09-16) and journal source compared: two CNNs trained on simulated data were tested on clinical data; median localization error 32 mm, up to 82% transmural detection, top-three localization error 20 mm. Same result lineage as the 2023 journal article; proof-of-principle only. These measurements establish a proof of principle in this study, not deployment benefit.
